_s9d_commandblock_basis: 1.21.8's BaseCommandBlock implemented CommandSource (sendSystemMessage recorded the output, acceptsSuccess / acceptsFailure / shouldInformAdmins) and declared createCommandSourceStack() abstract with the block as source (javap -c 1.21.8). 1.21.9 moved the four into a per-run source (BaseCommandBlock.CloseableCommandBlockSource) and takes it as createCommandSourceStack(source). The block is a CommandSource again with 1.21.8's bodies (mixin/CbCommandBlockRestoredMixin); while a converted mod mixes one of the four, the per-run source answers it from the block (CbCommandBlockOutputHooksMixin); a 1.21.8 subclass's createCommandSourceStack() is reached from 1.21.9's by mechanical.json's generated hook (its stack's source the block itself, recording through the restored sendSystemMessage).
